Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.account

Class RequestPasswordResetUseCase

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.account.RequestPasswordResetUseCase
@Service public class RequestPasswordResetUseCase extends Object
Use case that starts a password reset. It always succeeds from the caller's point of view: an unknown address is never mailed (so the endpoint cannot be used to send mail to arbitrary addresses) and costs the same token work (a token is generated and hashed either way), so the response never reveals whether an address is registered. The token is stored and mailed in one transaction: if the mail cannot be sent, no usable token is left behind.
